source_snapshot.procedure: Connect all network ports and query physical network adapters.
source_snapshot.criteria: All physical-adapter information correct; all sensors Status_Health OK.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Adapter specification, safe port topology and sensor-scope decision required.

old_problem: Physical-adapter identity and all-sensor health are different coverage domains, while the source provides neither their mapping nor a safe all-port cabling topology.
disposition_reason: ED-03 permits adapter, peer and sensor manifests as runtime configuration, and ED-09 keeps physical cabling manual. The two original Criteria remain independent checkpoints so generic sensor health cannot replace adapter coverage.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row337 all 18 XLSX columns and history2933.
Retained every physical adapter, every connected port, and the literal all-sensor health requirement as separately traceable evidence.
No cable was moved, log cleared or NVSM command run.

test_case.test_name: NVSM physical network-adapter inventory with separate sensor-health checkpoint
test_case.purpose: Verify every expected physical adapter and its properties, then independently verify the declared complete sensor set is healthy under an approved loop-safe port topology.
required_package: Complete sensor inventory and adapter association where applicable
test_case.test_command: An operator connects each named port to its approved peer; capture `nvsm show networkadapters` read-only and compare adapter identities/properties, then capture the complete declared NVSM sensor-health set as a separate checkpoint.
test_case.expected_result: Every expected physical adapter and port property matches the signed manifest with no missing/extra device, and every sensor in the separately declared complete inventory reports Status_Health OK.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: Both checkpoints must pass independently; all sensors OK cannot compensate for a missing or incorrect adapter, and correct adapters cannot compensate for a non-OK or omitted sensor.
safety_gate: Preserve diagnostics; no network mutation or automatic retry
expected_evidence: Photos or port-map attestation for manual connections
test_case.recovery: If cabling threatens a loop or management reachability, stop and have the network owner restore the documented original cabling; read-only collection needs no state rollback.

source_conflict.reason: Adapter correctness and all-sensor health are now explicit non-substitutable checkpoints with defined manifests.
